description: The arithmetic recursion graph existentially chooses two history codes, requires a decoded value at every index up to the input, requires every decoded value to obey the initial and transition clauses, and requires the proposed output to occur at the final index.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph {n : ℕ}
  (decoder : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin 3 ⊕ Unit))
  (base : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (step : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 2) ⊕ Unit)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Unit)
